name: Elsa Valentine
original_name: エルザ・ヴァレンタイン
source:
Favorite food: Chocolate

The student council president of a school in the republic and a servant of the government. She’s in a top position in the republic and aims to build an equal status comparable with that of her father. Though she says she dislikes the customs of the empire she actually loves their bathing customs.

Favorite food: Chocolate

The student council president of a school in the republic and a servant of the government. She’s in a top position in the republic and aims to build an equal status comparable with that of her father. Though she says she dislikes the customs of the empire she actually loves their bathing customs.
